profile.headline: Ecom Operations Manager at AMIRI
profile.summary: Based in Los Angeles, I've spent the past decade helping brands scale their ecommerce business and expand into global markets. I specialize in Shopify Plus development, conversion rate optimization (CRO), site performance, omnichannel initiatives like Shopify Collective, Buy with Prime, and B2B, as well as technical SEO and website compliance. My focus has always been on creating scalable solutions that improve customer experience and deliver measurable revenue growth.

positions.title: Ecom Operations Manager
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · On-site

positions.title: Web Software Developer
positions.description:
Led the global modernization of eight Shopify ecommerce sites across the US, UK, EU, and Hong Kong, improving UX, performance, SEO, and compliance while driving significant revenue growth and operational savings.

- Managed migration and redesign of 8 global storefronts, increasing YoY revenue by 16% (38% since migration), achieving 95+ Google Lighthouse scores, and launching new initiatives including Buy with Prime, SMU, and a flagship microsite.
- Reduced annual technology and operational costs by 43% ($195K+) through tech stack optimization, vendor negotiations, and in-house development, delivering a $200K project for under $15K while generating $1.7M additional revenue.
- Led technical SEO, AI Agents, ADA/WCAG, GDPR, and CCPA compliance while coordinating cross-functional teams across multiple international markets.
- Led the launch of the brand's largest online collaboration, partnering with artists and athletes including Rakeem Miles, Anwar Carrots, Jeremy Lin, Andrey Rublev.

positions.title: DTC Shopify Manager & Developer
positions.description:
Managed Shopify development and daily ecommerce operations for a furniture retailer, leading major site improvements, platform migrations, and customer experience initiatives while maintaining a catalog of 8,000+ SKUs.

- Redesigned key pages, migrated the site to a new Shopify theme, integrated the B2B wholesale business into the main store, and built a membership program that has generated 10,000+ member signups.
- Managed 8,000+ products and implemented AI search, collection filtering, dropshipping integrations, technical SEO, and other Shopify enhancements to improve site performance and streamline operations.
- Led the ecommerce launch of the brand's largest collaborations with Becky Owens and JoJo Fletcher, supporting merchandising, product launches, and promotional campaigns.

positions.title: Ecommerce Project Manager & Web Developer
positions.locationName: Long Beach, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Led ecommerce growth and digital strategy during a period in which the company tripled in size, driving major platform improvements, customer acquisition, and operational efficiency.

- Migrated the website from WooCommerce to Shopify, improved technical SEO, and introduced bilingual support, loyalty rewards, international payments, and live chat, contributing to $3.5M+ in revenue growth, a 240% increase in returning customers, and a 780% increase in new customer acquisition during Covid.
- Managed cross-functional teams using biweekly sprint planning and helped produce 300+ YouTube videos that grew the brand's audience to over 250K subscribers while supporting product launches and marketing campaigns.
positions.insights: Leadership, Event / Marketing Management and +29 skills

positions.title: Jr Project Manager & Web Developer
positions.description:
- Converted the B2B wholesale system (WMS) to a B2C e-commerce platform with new ERP migration integrations, generating $2M in revenue and implementing significant technological enhancements within the first quarter.
- Redesigned and developed a fully responsive DTC website with seamless integrations for Amazon, eBay, and multiple dropshippers.
- Published over 30 MSDS and qualifications on Amazon FBA, CVS & Walgreens boards, and Sephora guidelines, successfully facilitating entry into major online brands.
- Managed company communications using Slack and Jira, collecting user stories and feedback, coordinating trade shows, and maintaining internal updates.
positions.insights: Leadership, Social Media Advertisement and +30 skills
